title: Preserve independent capo values on multiple staves
scope: Support non-default capo values per staff and define compatibility with Track.CapoFret.
acceptance: A two-staff fixture with capos 2 and 5 retains both values and resulting pitches.
Document precedence for legacy track edits versus direct staff edits, with one source of authority.
Validate boundaries and preserve both capos through GP8 and AlphaTab without silently selecting one.

reproduction.instructions: A two-staff fixture with capos 2 and 5 retains both values and resulting pitches.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
